summary: Novo Nordisk filed a Form 6-K detailing its ongoing share repurchase programme. On 6 May 2026, it initiated a buyback under a 12-month programme of up to DKK 15 billion starting 4 February 2026, with a sub-programme up to DKK 11,200,000,010.45 through 1 February 2027. The report lists daily transactions from 13-17 July 2026 (195,000 B shares each day at DKK ~322-334 per share). As of 17 July, total repurchases since 4 February were 24,959,179 B shares at ~DKK 274.58 average, for DKK 6,853,177,389. Treasury shares now total 42,144,480 B shares (0.9% of capital). This routine buyback update signals a continued return of capital to shareholders via open-market purchases; watch for programme pace as a signal of management's view on intrinsic value and share price support.
